title: Athumi is Belgium's ZenDiS equivalent: a state-founded data utility running Solid Pods
content:
Athumi was founded in spring 2023 by the Flemish government and is described as Europe's first data utility company. It runs Solid Pods, which places personal data in stores the subject controls rather than in the systems of whoever collected it.

The research reads the entity structurally: Athumi is Belgium's equivalent of ZenDiS — a state-backed body with a sovereignty mandate, not a vendor that has adopted sovereignty as positioning. That distinction determines how a relationship works. The mandate is why the organisation exists, so alignment does not have to be established, and its choices carry public-policy weight rather than commercial preference.

Data-ownership-native is the third property recorded, and it is the closest of the three to this project's own assumptions. A utility built on Solid begins from the premise that the subject holds the data; what remains open is what was decided about that data, by whom, and under what authority. The lead sits on a parallel track in the workbook, which is the right handling for an institution rather than a supplier.
